profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc. is a public company, traded as SYM, headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001837240. Its website describes it as a provider of end-to-end warehouse automation for retailers and distributors, combining robotics and AI software to move goods through the supply chain. The company says its systems use dense storage to increase facility capacity and AI-enhanced software to raise throughput, and that its solutions can be adapted to palletized goods, small quantity fulfillment, and omnichannel operations.

According to the site, the systems handle items from as small as 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) up to 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) in their native packaging, with options for loose items and cold chain requirements. Symbotic describes itself as the software and key robotic innovator for each solution it sells, positioning its turnkey approach against integrators it says are limited by technology partnerships. It also describes itself as a leader in industrial automation and in technology at large.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with a count of 187. No products or MCP servers are tracked for it, and no individual cases are listed.
